items.computation: The invoice is dated 30.01.2026 (Rechnungsdatum) and payment is due within one month of that date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (30.01.2026) is not counted, so the period starts running on 31.01.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 3 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same calendar number as the start day; since February has no 30th day, it ends on the last day of February, i.e. Sat 28.02.2026. Since that day is a Saturday, under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 02.03.2026. To arrive on time given standard bank transfer processing (up to 1 business day, § 675s BGB), the transfer should be sent by Fri 27.02.2026.
